continuity_scope: Pass limited to N. K. Jemisin's The Fifth Season, Orbit first edition ISBN 9780316229296, Book One only. Excludes The Obelisk Gate, The Stone Sky, related short fiction, author commentary, companion material, and any adaptation.
coverage_rule: Nine named individual dramatic characters in this one novel. Identity presentation follows the witness: Essun's connections to other focal names are treated as a late-book disclosure, not expanded with later-series knowledge. Peoples, castes, comms, the Fulcrum, orogeny, obelisks, Seasons, and places remain dimensions or terms.
omissions: Books Two and Three, related stories, adaptations, and commentary.
Collective/institutional character nodes and source-native systems or artifacts.
uncertainties: Second-person narration, nonlinear timeline, and late identity disclosure constrain description.
Chapter loci are used because pagination differs by printing.
The novel depicts child abuse, ableist/caste oppression, reproductive coercion, murder, and disaster violence.
evidence_basis: Primary claims use the declared Orbit printed witness and chapter loci; Hachette/Orbit metadata establishes the edition, author, and Book One context.

supports: Author, Orbit publication context, and first-book status.
